picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in November 2026?
picks.why: Inflation persisting above 3.5% would limit Federal Reserve rate cuts and erode real wages heading into 2027.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: Unemployment rising above 4.2% would signal a cooling labor market and shift expectations for Federal Reserve policy.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Roughly a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation risks elevated.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI shapes where investment, talent, and market value concentrate across the technology sector.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a Millennium Prize problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with broad implications for research productivity.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce bankruptcy by December 31, 2029?
picks.why: Odds on OpenAI's solvency show whether markets expect heavy AI capital spending to earn enough to pay for itself.
